name: Comtech
summary: Albany WA regional dialup ISP + community portal (member dialup hours, 'Launch Pad'); operated independently into the early 2020s (COMTECH CORPORATION PTY LTD, ACN 074 915 585).

events.details: COMTECH CORPORATION PTY LTD ACN 074 915 585 registered 18 Jul 1996 (Albany WA); ran the comtech.net.au Albany community-ISP portal.

comtech.net.au ran as an Albany WA dialup ISP / community portal with live homepage captures through 2023, then went dark. The previously-recorded 'acquired by iiNet 1999' is unsupported: Comtech is absent from iiNet's acquisition history and the site operated independently long after 1999.
